example-convex-hull-3d.title: Convex Hull 3D
example-convex-hull-3d.description: A point cloud (the Stanford bunny, primitives, or random) and its convex hull, computed with maath's quickhull3 and drawn as a rainbow shell over the points.

example-convex-hull-2d.title: Convex Hull 2D
example-convex-hull-2d.description: A drifting 2D point cloud with its convex hull recomputed live (maath's quickhull2) — points light up as they wander onto the hull.

example-circumcircle.title: Circumcircle
example-circumcircle.description: A triangle that morphs between shapes with its circumcircle recomputed live (maath's circumcircle) — watch the circle balloon as the triangle flattens.

example-flow-field.title: Flow Field
example-flow-field.description: Hundreds of particles advected along an angle field from maath's simplex2d noise, leaving flowing rainbow trails.
